Internal positional compressed-source abstraction.

A ReadAtSource is a non-owning, thread-safe view. OwnedReadAtSource controls the lifetime of its platform handle or immutable test buffer.

Imports

errors, private/platform_io

Types

OwnedReadAtSource = ref object
  view*: ReadAtSource
Owner must outlive every worker using view.
